newsitem.title: USA: Wash. 1,158 MW nuclear plant to ramp down at night.
newsitem.headline: Wash. 1,158 MW nuclear plant to ramp down at night.

text.p: The 1,158 megawatt (MW) WNP-2 nuclear unit will "load cycle" this week, operating at maximum rates during the day but ramping down to 70 percent at night, a spokesman for the plant said Monday.

The schedule was requested by Bonneville Power Administration, which has plenty of hydropower on hand and does not need the nuclear power at night when demand eases, the Washington Public Power Supply System spokesman explained.
WNP-2 is expected to run at 92 percent power during the day this week due to a lingering problem with an adjustable speed drive, which since mid-January has curtailed the unit's operating level.
The unit will begin to power down around 2000 PST, aiming to operate at the 70 percent rate from 2200 to 0400 PST, the spokesman said.
